craft_notes: Sthāyin: fivefold stand. Rows: fullness then standing. Read aloud: five-beat stance.

lines: Here the Highest, with five mights replete,
they say; who, by his free will, displaying might on might,
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra parameśvaraḥ pañcabhiḥ śaktibhiḥ nirbhara ity uktam sa svātantryāt śaktiṃ tāṃ tāṃ mukhyatayā prakaṭayan pañcadhā tiṣṭhati
